title: Cover Windows owner bootstrap archive failure and scratch retention
outcome: A deterministic owner-level regression covers bootstrap archival failure, proving a nonzero owner exit, failed launcher stage and retained original short bootstrap evidence.
acceptance: An owned fixture deterministically makes the short bootstrap unavailable to archival after shell execution and exercises the existing production guardian archive-error branch.

The regression asserts nonzero owner exit, failed launcher result and retained scratch/evidence, without retries, timeout inflation, changing successful archival semantics or touching unrelated directories.
